Cricketer Yuzvendra Chahal Joins BJP's OBC Morcha

Cricketer Yuzvendra Chahal has joined the Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) Other Backward Classes (OBC) Morcha in Haryana. He was inducted as a 'special invitee' into the wing. Chahal is known for being a prominent T20 bowler, having taken over 400 wickets in the format.
